theme_central: From cheating in measure and weight — a failure of the most concrete everyday justice — to the final reversal: those who laughed at the believers will themselves become objects of laughter.
sources_note: Content widely taught and undisputed: Sijjin (register of the wicked) and 'Illiyyin (register of the righteous) are well-established classical landmarks.

branches.title: Woe to the cheaters
branches.resume: Demanding full measure when buying, giving less when selling or weighing; do they not think they will be resurrected?

children.t: Cheating in measure and weight, the coming resurrection

branches.title: Register of the wicked (Sijjin)
branches.resume: Sealed register of the wicked; a veil will cover them that Day from the sight of their Lord.

children.t: Register of the wicked in Sijjin, veil preventing them from seeing their Lord

branches.title: Register of the righteous ('Illiyyin)
branches.resume: Register of the righteous, witnessed by those brought near; a sealed drink of musk mixed with Tasnim.

children.t: Register of the righteous in 'Illiyyin, drink of musk and Tasnim

branches.title: The reversal
branches.resume: The criminals used to laugh at the believers in this world; that Day, the believers will laugh in turn, from their couches.

children.t: Reversal: the believers laugh in turn at the disbelievers that Day
